content.comment_body: I am looking for information on the hardware type for [article_no], and would like to confirm if it is compatible with [product_name] [version_no].

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. The module with order number [article_no] is a digital expansion module for a [product_name] [version_no] base unit. You simply connect it to the base module. Unlike other systems, there is no detailed hardware configuration in [product_name], just the selection of the basic module. Edit: The statement from [user_name] is correct. I had misread the order number previously. Please check out this link: [document]

Hi, the module [article_no] is an older version of [product_name] [version_no]. For programming, you will need [product_name] [version_no] (later versions like [version_no] also work) and a suitable programming cable. I recall the base module must be set to transfer mode to download programs, but it has been a long time since I used this setup. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure about compatibility and software requirements for older [company_name] modules, specifically the product with article number [article_no]. There is confusion about hardware identification and suitable programming software, and a lack of clear hardware configuration steps in the software leads to uncertainty about working with legacy products.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear information regarding the hardware version of the module and confirmation of compatibility with [product_name] [version_no]. Guidance on programming procedures and hardware setup in the software is also desired.
